svg.title: Max and min deques for [10, 1, 2, 4, 7, 2] with limit 5
svg.desc: Window, max deque and min deque after each step; the max deque front (amber) is the window max, the min deque front (violet) is the window min. Answer 4
svg.text: longest subarray with max − min ≤ 5 in [10, 1, 2, 4, 7, 2]
max deque values fall left to right; min deque values rise
